recipe: When a type needs to represent all possible values of a set of keys (e.g., cookie names), use TypeScript's `keyof` operator on the object type to produce a string literal union.
trigger_condition: You need a type that is a union of all keys/names from an object-like structure rather than a single string.
evidence: Your goal is to update `CookieSurveyInput` so that it will return a union of all of the names of the various different cookies.
source_name: TypeHero: Advent of TypeScript 2023, Day Two
